headline: Quiet day as the Five Eyes jolt settles
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Lines barely moved after yesterday's Five Eyes warning; Self-Destruction, Protector God and Enslaved God slipped by a few hundredths as earlier stories faded. The darker reading set on June 22 stays largely in place. Horizon Balance held at +1.60.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
